AP-DESTRUCTIVE-UNDO.rule: Refunds MUST NOT delete or mutate Order, Ledger, Seat, or TicketCredential truth records. They MUST create compensating, append-only records.

AP-MONEY_WITHOUT_REVOCATION.rule: Refund finalization for admission-linked items MUST NOT occur unless TKT-1 credential revocation has been recorded and is eligible for scanner hydration.

AP-REFUND_DURING_DISPUTE.rule: Refunds MUST NOT be executed while PAY-3 reports an active dispute for the relevant payment_reference/verified_payment_attempt_id unless policy explicitly allows it; the conflict MUST be deterministic.

ATP-REFUND-010.text: Lock-on-Conn-A / Write-on-Conn-B split: taking an advisory/idempotency lock in one DB session and performing the protected mutation in another session. This provides zero safety and enables zombie double-refunds.

ATP-REFUND-011.text: Unfenced refund mutation: implementing process_refund without SM-0 CAS fencing (status predicate + fencing token / lock_version) or without a serialization guard, allowing duplicate refunds under retries/concurrency.

fields.description: Occurrence scope for this refund. RefundRequests MUST be occurrence-scoped to preserve admission and scan semantics.
fields.name: occurrence_id

fields.description: If present, groups multiple org-scoped orders created from a single multi-org checkout. Derived from ORD-1.
fields.name: checkout_group_id

fields.description: Snapshot of organizer payout bucket at time of refund posting selection. Determines ledger template eligibility.
fields.name: payout_bucket

fields.description: How the platform recovers refunded platform fees from the organizer when fee_refund_policy requires organizer absorption.
fields.name: fee_recovery_mode

fields.description: Stable reason code for why platform fees are refunded (exception case). REQUIRED when refunded_fee_minor > 0. Uppercase snake_case.
fields.name: fee_refund_reason_code

fields.description: sha256 hex digest of TAX-1 tax context used for this refund; MUST match the digest for the order price snapshot tax context.
fields.name: tax_context_digest_sha256

fields.description: Authoritative TAX-1 TaxProfile identifier used at point-of-sale for the order being refunded. MUST be copied from the ORD-1 snapshot / TAX-1 OrderTaxRecord and MUST NOT be sourced from UI inputs.
fields.name: tax_profile_id

fields.description: Tax inclusion mode (inclusive/exclusive) from TAX-1 OrderTaxRecord for the order snapshot. Used for deterministic refund tax apportionment and credit-note generation.
fields.name: tax_inclusion_mode

fields.description: Rounding mode from TAX-1 OrderTaxRecord for the order snapshot. Refund math MUST reuse this to prevent penny leaks across partial refunds.
fields.name: tax_rounding_mode

fields.description: Total platform fee minor units that fall within the refund scope (from order price snapshot). MUST equal refunded_fee_minor + platform_fee_retained_minor.
fields.name: fee_total_in_scope_minor

fields.description: Amount the payment provider was instructed to refund (minor units). Mirrors PAY-3 execute_refund request for reconciliation.
fields.name: provider_refund_amount_minor

fields.description: Digest version for tax_context_digest_sha256. MUST match TAX-1 OrderTaxRecord.tax_context_digest_version. New refunds MUST use TAXCTX-V2.
fields.name: tax_context_digest_version

fields.description: PITIC digest copied from authoritative OrderTaxRecord at point-of-sale. Prevents ID-only tax law drift.
fields.name: tax_law_config_digest_sha256

fields.description: PITIC digest copied from OrderTaxRecord credit-note reporting profile at point-of-sale.
fields.name: credit_note_reporting_profile_digest_sha256

fields.description: sha256 of normalized jurisdiction evidence used at point-of-sale, copied from OrderTaxRecord to survive PII rotation/purge.
fields.name: jurisdiction_evidence_sha256

fields.description: sha256 of the authoritative apportionment priority map captured at order finalization. Refund remainder distribution MUST use this map; fail closed if absent.
fields.name: order_tax_apportionment_priority_map_sha256

fields.description: Authoritative sale-time apportionment priority map (ordered list of taxable line_item_id values). Refund remainder distribution MUST follow this order. MUST match order_tax_apportionment_priority_map_sha256.
fields.name: order_tax_apportionment_priority_map

resources.purpose: State machine for an idempotent refund orchestration attempt. Persists anchors needed for reconciliation and downstream revocation.

process_refund.purpose: Orchestrate the compensating reversal to completion (async-safe; may be resumed).
steps: 1) Acquire idempotency lock for (org_id, refund_id) using LOCKS-1; fail closed on lock reuse mismatch.
2) Load RefundRequest; validate status is requested or approved; validate org_id tenancy (TEN-1).

3) Load authoritative order snapshot from ORD-1 (price_snapshot + fee_snapshot + payment_reference + verified_payment_attempt_id + checkout_group_id) and bind occurrence_id. RefundRequest MUST be occurrence-scoped: all referenced order_item_ids/credential_ids MUST map to the same occurrence_id.

4) Derive refund totals from snapshots: principal_refund_minor, refunded_fee_minor, platform_fee_retained_minor, fee_total_in_scope_minor, and tax_portion_minor using TAX-1. Caller-supplied totals MUST NOT be trusted except for admin override requests (request_refund).

5) Enforce SD-011 fee constitution: if refunded_fee_minor > 0 then fee_refund_policy MUST be customer_full_refund_organizer_absorbs_fee, fee_refund_reason_code MUST be present, and fee_recovery_mode MUST be present. If payout_bucket is organizer_paid_out then fee_recovery_mode MUST be invoice_receivable and refund MUST be routed to manual_review (no automated provider refund).

6) Execute provider refund via PAY-3 execute_refund using computed provider_refund_amount_minor (= amount_minor) and currency_iso. PAY-3 is provider-truth; REFUND-1 MUST store verified_payment_attempt_id and provider_refund_reference.

7) Post ledger intent via LED-1 using template selection: REFUND_FULL_ABSORBED_PENDING/AVAILABLE when fee_refund_policy requires organizer absorption and payout_bucket permits payout deduction; otherwise REFUND_PRIN_ONLY_PENDING/AVAILABLE. Args MUST include refund_minor, tax_minor, currency (MUST equal currency_iso), counterparty_org_id, and refund_id. fee_minor MUST be included IFF template is REFUND_FULL_ABSORBED_* and MUST equal refunded_fee_minor.
8) Revoke admission credentials and seat holds: call TKT-1 to create ticket_revocation_batch, then call SEAT-1 to release any held/claimed seats in scope (if applicable).
9) Finalize RefundRequest: set refunded_at_utc, status=finalized, and emit outbox event ticketing.refund.finalized.v1.

request_refund.intent: Admin/system override refund request. Allows explicit amount_minor only with dual-control governance and evidence. Not callable by customers.
request_refund.purpose: Create (or return) an idempotent RefundRequest in status=requested. Does not execute side effects.

request_refund_customer.authorization: MUST enforce org-scoped authorization (TEN-1/IAM-1). actor_kind determines caller privileges; customer calls cannot set admin_case_id or override evidence.
request_refund_customer.idempotency: Idempotent by (org_id, idempotency_key). If a request already exists for the same idempotency_key, it MUST return the existing refund_id.
request_refund_customer.intent: Customer/organizer-initiated refund request. Caller MUST NOT provide money totals or fee/tax amounts; the system derives amounts from ORD-1/PRICE-1 snapshots and TAX-1.

notes: decision MUST be one of: approve | deny.
On approve: REFUND-1 MUST set status=validating and persist override_* fields so process_refund may proceed deterministically.
On deny: REFUND-1 MUST set status=denied, set denied_at_utc and denied_subcode (ERR-1), and MUST NOT execute side effects.
review_refund.purpose: Record a manual review decision for a refund that is blocked by policy (lock window, post-entry, or other override-required conditions).

notes: Executed during refund finalization before any LED-1 writes.
Consumers MUST NOT trust presence of sha alone; sha MUST be recomputed and compared.
verify_priority_map_integrity!.summary: Recalculate sha256(utf8(JCS(order_tax_apportionment_priority_map))) per SEC-1 and assert equality with order_tax_apportionment_priority_map_sha256. Fail closed on mismatch.

active_dispute_blocks_refund: Active dispute status from PAY-3 is treated as a risk flag.
REFUND-1 MUST NOT execute or finalize a standard refund while dispute_active is true.
Exception: refund_kind == dispute_chargeback MAY proceed (dispute reconciliation).
On block, REFUND-1 MUST fail deterministically with ERR-1 subcode REFUND_DISPUTE_ACTIVE and MUST NOT post LED-1 or SEAT-1 reversals.
Any admin override pathway MUST be explicit, auditable, and MUST NOT be available while dispute_active is true (ERR-1 GOV_ADMIN_OVERRIDE_BLOCKED_DISPUTE_ACTIVE).

atomic_finalize.rule: A RefundRequest is FINALIZED only after: PAY-3 refund primitive succeeded, LED-1 contra-posting succeeded, SEAT-1 reversals (if applicable) succeeded, and TKT-1 credential revocation succeeded.

domain_invariants.authoritative_boundary: REFUND-1 is the orchestration contract only. Money movement truth and provider-side refund/dispute state are authoritative in PAY-3. REFUND-1 MUST NOT create a second refund authority: it may request provider refunds via PAY-3 and must persist provider references, but may not assert completion if PAY-3 does not.
concurrency_and_fencing: REFUND-1-INV-010 (ZOMBIE_HARDENING): process_refund MUST be implemented as a fenced state transition using SM-0 CAS semantics (compare-and-swap on status + fencing token / lock_version). Blind updates are forbidden.

REFUND-1-INV-011 (NO_PARALLEL_EXEC): process_refund MUST be serialized per refund_id (and per order_id where applicable). Parallel execution (multiple workers mutating the same refund) is forbidden; enforce via idempotency/advisory lock + Oban uniqueness.

REFUND-1-INV-012 (IDEMPOTENT_SIDE_EFFECTS): retries MUST be no-op or deterministically resume; ledger contra-postings and provider calls MUST be idempotent and keyed by refund_id + provider_refund_id (if present).

credential_revocation_binding.rule: Refund finalization MUST create TicketRevocation records (via TKT-1) for every affected credential_id with revocation_authority=refund and reason_subcode referencing ERR-1. Old credentials MUST fail SCAN-1 validation, including offline, once devices hydrate.

explainability.rule: All refund failures, denials, and policy conflicts MUST use ERR-1 reason_subcodes; free-form reason enums MUST NOT be used for decisions or UI.

domain_invariants.fee_arithmetic_truth: fee_total_in_scope_minor MUST equal refunded_fee_minor + platform_fee_retained_minor. If fee_total_in_scope_minor is 0 then refunded_fee_minor MUST be 0.

idempotency.rule: Refund processing MUST be idempotent per (org_id, idempotency_key). Replays MUST return the existing RefundRequest and MUST NOT double-execute any side effect. When calling LED-1 and PAY-3, REFUND-1 MUST use deterministic idempotency keys and MUST bind the semantic intent using ledger_idempotency_payload_hash_sha256 to prevent replay-with-different-payload attacks.

ledger_period_readability_interlock.rule: Before finalizing a refund, the refund engine MUST validate via LED-1 that the originating ledger period for the order is readable for reversal postings and that the tax contra account mapping referenced by the OrderTaxRecord remains valid. If ledger period is closed/non-readable or mapping invalid, refund MUST fail closed with an ERR-1 subcode.

domain_invariants.ledger_template_arg_contract: LED-1 intent template selection MUST be consistent with fee refund arithmetic: if refunded_fee_minor == 0 then template MUST be REFUND_PRIN_ONLY_PENDING/AVAILABLE and LED args MUST NOT include fee_minor; if refunded_fee_minor > 0 then fee_refund_policy MUST be customer_full_refund_organizer_absorbs_fee and template MUST be REFUND_FULL_ABSORBED_PENDING/AVAILABLE with fee_minor==refunded_fee_minor. In all cases LED arg currency MUST be provided as 'currency' and MUST equal currency_iso.

money_confirmed_precondition.rule: A refund MUST reference an ORD-1 money-confirmed anchor (payment_reference + verified_payment_attempt_id) and MUST NOT finalize against non-final or partial money states unless refund_kind=goodwill and policy allows.

domain_invariants.occurrence_scope: RefundRequests MUST be occurrence-scoped. order_total scope is only permitted when the underlying order contains exactly one occurrence_id. If a caller attempts an order_total refund on a multi-occurrence order, the request MUST be rejected (fail closed) and callers MUST submit per-occurrence refunds.

override_evidence_quorum_binding.rule: When a refund proceeds via manual approval (status=manual_review) or any override path (system_cancel, goodwill, or fee_refund exceptions), override_evidence_digest_sha256 MUST be present and MUST be the sha256 hex digest of an evidence package that includes a QUORUM-1 attestation for this refund override. The QUORUM-1 attestation transcript MUST bind at minimum: refund_id, order_id, occurrence_id, amount_minor, currency_iso, tax_portion_minor, tax_context_digest_sha256, fee_refund_policy, refunded_fee_minor, and reason_subcode. Signatures MUST be from distinct quorum identities per QUORUM-1 invariants; replay across different refund_id MUST be cryptographically invalid.

domain_invariants.payout_bucket_template_selection: When fee_refund_policy is customer_full_refund_organizer_absorbs_fee and fee_recovery_mode is payout_deduction, payout_bucket MUST be organizer_payable_pending or organizer_payable_available, and the ledger template MUST be REFUND_FULL_ABSORBED_PENDING/AVAILABLE accordingly (LED-1). If payout_bucket is organizer_paid_out, automated ledger posting for fee recovery is forbidden.
domain_invariants.platform_fee_refund_policy: Platform fees are non-refundable by default (SD-011). If a refund includes any refunded_fee_minor > 0, it is an exception and MUST be explicitly opted-in: fee_refund_policy MUST be customer_full_refund_organizer_absorbs_fee. The organizer MUST absorb the refunded platform fees, recovered via payout_deduction (when payout_bucket is organizer_payable_pending or organizer_payable_available) or routed to invoice_receivable with manual review when organizer_paid_out. fee_refund_reason_code MUST be present for auditability.

refund_after_entry_policy.rule: REFUND-1 MUST enforce a deterministic refund-after-entry policy per (org_id, occurrence_id, ticket_id) using SCAN-1 RedemptionStatus. REFUND-1 MUST derive affected tuples from (a) credential_ids via TKT-1 TicketCredential.ticket_id + TicketCredential.occurrence_ids; and/or (b) order_item_ids via ORD-1 immutable order snapshot items. If any affected tuple has redemption_state==redeemed at time of processing, then refund_kind in {customer_request, organizer_initiated, goodwill} MUST be denied by setting status=denied, setting denied_at_utc, and setting denied_subcode=REFUND_AFTER_ENTRY_FORBIDDEN (ERR-1). Exceptions: (1) refund_kind==system_cancel MAY proceed only via manual_review (status=manual_review) and only after explicit approval is recorded via REFUND-1 review_refund (admin_case_id + override_evidence_digest_sha256 + override_approved_by_actor_id + override_approved_at_utc). (2) refund_kind==dispute_chargeback MAY proceed as dispute reconciliation (PAY-3 precedence). When proceeding under an exception and RedemptionStatus.winner_scan_id points to a Scan row where provisional==true, REFUND-1 MUST record operator notice SCAN_MANIFEST_TOO_OLD (ERR-1) into RefundRequest.reason_detail. All refunds (including automated) MUST have admin_case_id populated for cross-system correlation (SEAT reversals, LED intents, audit).

refund_lock_window.rule: For admission-linked refunds, REFUND-1 MUST compute a per-occurrence refund_lock_window anchored to EVT-2 check_in_open_at_utc..check_in_close_at_utc. During the window, auto-refunds MUST be forbidden; the RefundRequest MUST be routed to status=manual_review and MAY only proceed after an explicit manual approval is recorded using REFUND-1 review_refund (persisting admin_case_id + override_evidence_digest_sha256 + override_approved_by_actor_id + override_approved_at_utc). Affecting occurrence_ids MUST be derived from TKT-1 TicketCredential.occurrence_ids when credential_ids are supplied; otherwise derived from ORD-1 order snapshot items.

tax_apportionment_determinism.rule: For any partial refund where amount_minor represents a strict subset of the original order principal, REFUND-1 MUST compute tax_portion_minor using the TAX-1 deterministic apportionment algorithm and the snapshot tax_rounding_mode and tax_inclusion_mode, anchored by tax_context_digest_sha256 and tax_profile_id. The computation MUST be integer-only (minor units) and MUST NOT use floating point. If TAX-1 defines multiple apportionment strategies, REFUND-1 MUST use the strategy designated for refunds/credit-notes. Tie-breakers for distributing remainder minor-units MUST be stable and deterministic: (1) highest fractional remainder, then (2) lowest order_item_id 16-byte lexicographic (raw UUID bytes; memcmp), then (3) lowest refund_id 16-byte lexicographic (raw UUID bytes; memcmp). The sum of tax_portion_minor across a set of disjoint partial refunds for the same original principal MUST equal the original tax total for that principal (subject to the TAX-1 rounding_mode), otherwise the refund MUST fail closed. Remainder distribution MUST be driven by the order-authoritative apportionment_priority_map (hash in order_tax_apportionment_priority_map_sha256). Concurrent refunds against the same order MUST serialize via an order-level lock and MUST record consumed remainder slots as part of the ledger idempotency key to prevent double-claiming the same minor-unit remainder.

tax_apportionment_priority_map_required.rule: Refund tax apportionment MUST use the order-authoritative tax_apportionment_priority_map captured at order finalization (ORD-1>=3.7.10). REFUND-1 MUST persist both (a) order_tax_apportionment_priority_map (array[uuid_v7]) and (b) order_tax_apportionment_priority_map_sha256. The sha MUST equal sha256(utf8(JCS(order_tax_apportionment_priority_map))) using SEC-1 JCS byte-truth rules. If the authoritative map is absent because the originating order snapshot predates ORD-1 v3.7.10, REFUND-1 MUST derive a legacy priority map deterministically by stable-sorting the taxable line_item_ids (uuid_v7) ascending, MUST persist it, and MUST set legacy_derived=true. If map/sha is missing or mismatched for non-legacy orders, refund finalization MUST fail closed with ERR-1 code refund.tax.apportionment_anchor_invalid.

tax_apportionment_strict_map.rule: Refund tax apportionment MUST be reconstructed from the immutable ORD-1 OrderPriceSnapshot.tax_apportionment_priority_map that was used at purchase-time. Deriving or guessing the map from line items is FORBIDDEN. If the map is missing or cannot be verified, the refund MUST fail-closed.

tax_context_digest_parity.rule: RefundRequests MUST persist tax_context_digest_sha256 (sha256 hex) equal to the authoritative TAX-1 tax_context_digest_sha256 for the occurrence/order tax context used by the ORD-1 price snapshot. RefundRequests MUST NOT recompute tax context from UI inputs. If the digest does not match the ORD-1 snapshot tax_context_digest_sha256 (if present) and the TAX-1 computed digest for the occurrence, the refund MUST fail closed. RefundRequests MUST also persist tax_profile_id, tax_inclusion_mode, and tax_rounding_mode copied from the authoritative TAX-1 OrderTaxRecord used by the ORD-1 snapshot.

tax_digest_tenancy_salt_required.rule: RefundRequest.tax_context_digest_sha256 MUST be computed under TAXCTX-V2 rules that include org_id as an input component. Refund processing MUST reject any digest that does not declare tax_context_digest_version=TAXCTX-V2, unless explicitly grandfathered.

tax_portion_required.rule: RefundRequests MUST persist tax_portion_minor representing the tax liability portion included in amount_minor. LED-1 postings MUST reverse Platform_Tax_Liability by exactly tax_portion_minor for the refunded principal. tax_portion_minor MUST be derived from the ORD-1 price snapshot (authoritative math) and MUST NOT be recomputed from UI inputs. For partial refunds, tax_portion_minor MUST be computed using REFUND-1 tax_apportionment_determinism and MUST remain reconcilable back to the original ORD-1 snapshot totals.

tax_time_travel_pitic_pinning.rule: RefundRequest MUST carry PITIC digests copied from the authoritative OrderTaxRecord: tax_law_config_digest_sha256, credit_note_reporting_profile_digest_sha256, jurisdiction_evidence_sha256, and tax_context_digest_version. Refund computation MUST NOT dereference mutable TaxProfile/TaxRate records to re-derive these values.

outbox_events.notes: Emitted exactly once when a refund reaches status=finalized. occurrence_id is required to preserve admission/scan revocation semantics.

summary: Defines the authoritative, idempotent orchestration of refunds and other money reversals. Coordinates PAY-3 (refund primitives + dispute precedence), LED-1 (contra ledger posting), SEAT-1 (inventory/seat reversals), and TKT-1 (credential revocation) under strict multi-tenancy. Refund finalization MUST deterministically revoke admission credentials and MUST be explainable via ERR-1 reason_subcodes.
title: REFUND-1 Refund Orchestration & Compensating Reversal
